{{Quote|The long and short of it: we've identified three major sections of the crash where the situation is deteriorating, each with their own issues. Not many details beyond that.|[[Pordav|Doctor Pordav]], Disaster Response Lead for the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]]| <ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" />}}
The '''''Jannimak'' crash site''' was a location where the [[research vessel]] known as the ''[[Jannimak]]''<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" /> mysteriously [[Crash of the Jannimak|crashed]] into the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]<ref name="Crash Site Outpost">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Crash Site Outpost}}</ref> at some point around [[3622 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The ship was carrying many exotic species of animals, plants and fungi, and the ship's systems designed to accommodate the life-forms aboard began rapidly changing the planet's surface to create suitable habitats. 

Sometime after the disaster, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Pordav]] with [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]],<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" /> a subsidiary of [[Galactic Solutions Industries]],<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|[[Galactic Sustainability Institute]]}}</ref> led the response to the planet and set up an [[Jannimak Crash Site Outpost|outpost]] near the crash site.<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" /> Pordav's team designated three distinct areas in the crash, with drastically different environmental conditions: "[[Glacial Trespass]]" - a habitat of extreme cold, "[[Geothermal Disruption]]" - a habitat of extremely high temperatures and "[[Sporefall]]" - a habitat with highly [[Mushroom/Legends|spore]]-active air, poisonous for most outsiders.<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" /> Several scientific teams were dispatched to all three areas,<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" /> but as the conditions proved extremely hazardous, [[Pordav]] started looking for outside help, searching for mercenaries<ref>{{TORcite|type=codex|[[Geothermal Disruption]]}}</ref> and eventually contacting [[Alliance Commander]] themself.<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" />
